products.product: Matches scale tickets, material type, job, customer allowance, disposal markup, and invoice to find unrecovered fees.
products.audience: roll-off, junk removal, and waste-hauling companies
products.problem: Disposal cost is paid at the facility but not fully passed through when tickets and customer invoices are reconciled manually.
products.valueProposition: Finds missing or underbilled disposal charges and produces the supporting ticket before the billing period closes.
products.startupCost: Solo MVP: web app, CSV import, managed database, and optional read-only integrations.
products.seoAngle: Targets purchase and problem-aware searches including: landfill ticket reconciliation software; disposal fee billing audit; dumpster overage charge tracking; waste disposal fee billing reconciliation software; waste disposal fee billing reconciliation calculator; waste disposal fee billing reconciliation pricing
products.seoThesis: A narrow site for roll-off, junk removal, and waste-hauling companies can connect commercial pages, calculators, comparisons, and implementation guides around waste disposal fee billing reconciliation to the same measurable revenue-capture outcome.
searchQueries: waste disposal fee billing reconciliation software
waste disposal fee billing reconciliation calculator
waste disposal fee billing reconciliation pricing
products.profitRationale: The product recovers a direct variable cost on every eligible job and can work from document uploads before integrations.
products.primaryRisk: Ticket OCR and customer-specific allowance rules must be reliable and reviewable.
